evidence.title: GitHub - w3-kit/ui: Web3 React component library

name: w3-kit
summary: React component library of 27 web3 UI components and 12 primitives for wallets, DeFi, NFTs and transactions.
description: A React, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript component library for blockchain apps and dApps: 27 interactive components covering connect wallet, network switcher, wallet balance, address book, multisig, token swap, staking, bridge, limit orders, NFT cards and collections, token lists, transaction history, smart contract tools, ENS resolver, gas calculator and subscription payments, plus 12 primitives. Distributed as shadcn registry items and copy-paste code.
contains: component groups: wallet, DeFi, NFT, tokens, transactions, contract, ENS, gas, plans, airdrops, vesting
React + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript, MIT licensed
